finalText:
Redis died at 2:14am and never came back. Every reconnect try failed, straight through to attempt 12 at 2:31am.

Without Redis, every request hit the store directly. Queue depth climbed past its limit of 500, all the way to 568. Requests kept timing out.

At 2:31:44am `worker-2` ran out of memory from the backlog and crashed. The supervisor restarted it, but eight seconds later the whole API stopped responding and got killed.

Root cause: Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` going down with no fallback that could handle the load. Fix Redis first, then look at capping the queue so it fails fast instead of piling up.
